title: Imani Mai Boye A Cikin Bango na Fadar
intro: A tsakiyar kotun zalunci mai cike da makirci da alfahari, wata rai kaɗai tana riƙe da wani sirri mai haɗari. Wannan bawan Allah yana kallon wani manzo yana tsaye shi kaɗai a kan wata daula. Lokacin da shiru ya zama haɗin gwiwa, dole ne a yanke shawara mai ƙarfi don faɗin gaskiya cikin babban haɗari.
clues: Na zauna a tsakanin mutane masu ƙarfi da girman kai waɗanda suka ƙi ayoyin Allah.
Na ɓoye imanina na ɗan lokaci yayin da waɗanda ke kewaye da ni suka yi makirci a kan wani manzo.
Na yi magana a fili, ina cewa: Shin kuna kashe mutum ne saboda suna cewa, Ubangijina Allah ne, alhali kuwa hujjoji bayyanannu sun zo?
Na yi wa mutanena gargaɗi game da makomar ƙasashen da suka gabata da kuma game da Ranar Kiran Juna.
Na gaya musu cewa mai mulkin da na yi wa hidima yana nuna ra'ayi kaɗan ne kawai, amma Lahira ita ce ainihin gida.
Na ce: Ya ku mutanena, ku bi ni, zan shiryar da ku zuwa ga hanya madaidaiciya, kuma Allah ya cece ni daga sharrin makircinsu.

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
